methodology: Used firecrawl search to locate portals, then firecrawl scrape with markdown+rawHtml formats. Compared rendered markdown against static rawHtml to classify static vs JS-rendered. Verified detail-page public accessibility and field completeness.
reference_baseline: Texas ESBD (https://www.txsmartbuy.gov/esbd) — static HTML table + public detail pages, scrapable with HTTP fetch + cheerio.

florida.primary_recommendation: MIXED — MFMP (rich) needs JS/API; DMS Current Bid Opportunities is static-scrapable but limited fields.

new_york.primary_recommendation: OGS Bid Opportunities — fully static (listing + detail), like Texas ESBD. Covers centralized contracts only.

georgia.primary_recommendation: Georgia Procurement Registry (GPR) — fully static (listing + detail), excellent. Best target.

north_carolina.primary_recommendation: NC eVP Solicitations — listing server-rendered in static HTML; detail values in form-input value attributes. Scrapable but detail parsing is non-trivial.

portals.name: MyFloridaMarketPlace (MFMP) Vendor Information Portal
portals.rendering: JS-rendered (Angular SPA). Static HTML contains an empty <mfmp-bid-table> component; results load via backend API only after a search is submitted. Even after triggering Search + waiting, no rows appear in static HTML (an empty search returns nothing). main.js bundle is minified with no public REST endpoint string.
portals.scrapable_notes: Listing requires browser automation or reverse-engineering the private Angular API. Detail pages are public and rich, but there is no crawlable static listing to discover the numeric detail IDs (would require ID enumeration).

portals.name: Florida DMS — Current Bid Opportunities (bulletin notices)
portals.pagination: ?page=N (1,306 results across 66 pages at time of scrape)
portals.rendering: Static HTML (Next.js site, server-rendered). Listing table and pagination links present in rawHtml.
portals.detail_fields_available: Links to per-opportunity DMS bulletin pages (titles use en-dashes/ampersands, HTML-entity encoded in source).
portals.scrapable_notes: Simple static table. Downside: limited listing fields (no due-date or status column; these are curated 'bulletin notices' rather than the full MFMP solicitation list). Best simple-scrape option for Florida.

portals.name: NYS OGS — Procurement Services Bid Calendar (centralized contracts)
portals.rendering: Static HTML. Bid table verified present in rawHtml (titles appear HTML-entity encoded, e.g. 'Snow & Ice').
detail_fields_available: Attachments table (Solicitation, Appendices, Attachments) with file type (PDF/EXCEL) and revision dates
portals.scrapable_notes: Excellent static target — closest analogue to Texas ESBD among these four states. Caveat: this is OGS centralized contracting only, a subset of all NY opportunities (the comprehensive source is NYSCR, which is not simple-scrapable).

portals.name: NYS Contract Reporter (NYSCR) — comprehensive statewide portal
portals.rendering: JS/POST-rendered (ASP.NET MVC). Static HTML exposes only the filter sidebar (agency, classification, category, location, date range). No result rows and no /Ads/Detail links appear without submitting a search. Homepage advertises ~826 total opportunities.
portals.detail_publicly_accessible: Likely yes (individual ads viewable) but not reachable from a static listing fetch.
portals.scrapable_notes: Would require reverse-engineering the ASP.NET search form POST (viewstate etc.) or browser automation. Skip for simple-scrape; prefer OGS for NY.

portals.name: Georgia Procurement Registry (GPR)
portals.pagination: Server-side, 11 pages; 'Show 10/25/50/100 entries' control; Previous/Next with page numbers.
portals.rendering: Static HTML. Full opportunity table (Event IDs, titles, links) verified present in rawHtml.
search_filters_available: Event Status (AWARDED/CANCELLED/CLOSED/COMPLETED/NOTICE OF INTENT TO AWARD/OPEN/UNDER EVALUATION)
detail_fields_available: Start Date / End Date / Ends In
portals.scrapable_notes: Best Georgia target. Fully public, fully static, rich detail pages. Equivalent quality to Texas ESBD. (Registration only needed to SUBMIT bids.)

portals.name: Team Georgia Marketplace (TGM) / GA@WORK
portals.rendering: doas.ga.gov pages are informational landing pages only (no listings). The actual TGM app (fscm.teamworks.georgia.gov) is PeopleSoft and requires supplier login.
portals.scrapable_notes: Login-gated PeopleSoft. Not public. Use GPR instead.

portals.name: NC electronic Vendor Portal (eVP) — Solicitations
portals.pagination: 21 pages of results; filter UI (status/department/category/posted-date/bid-opening-date) drives query params.
portals.rendering: Power Apps (Dynamics) portal. However the listing table IS server-rendered in the static HTML (verified: opportunity titles, solicitation numbers, and detail links all present in rawHtml). Detail pages also server-render field values, but into form-input value attributes rather than plain text.
search_filters_available: Department Type (State Agency/Community College/Public Schools/University/Local Government)
portals.detail_extraction_caveat: Detail values live in ASP.NET form input value attributes (e.g. name="...evp_posteddate" value="2026-07-23T...") rather than plain HTML text. Parseable, but requires reading input values/selects, not just text nodes.
portals.scrapable_notes: Listing is straightforward static scraping. Detail is public and server-rendered but needs form-control value extraction. 'Sign in' is only required to RESPOND to a solicitation, not to view. Overall scrapable with HTTP+cheerio.

tier_1_scrapable_now_like_texas_esbd: New York — OGS: https://ogs.ny.gov/procurement/bid-opportunities  (fully static, centralized contracts)
North Carolina — eVP: https://evp.nc.gov/solicitations/  (static listing; detail needs input-value parsing)
tier_2_needs_js_or_api_or_login: Florida — MFMP: https://vendor.myfloridamarketplace.com/search/bids  (Angular SPA listing; public detail pages)
New York — NYSCR: https://www.nyscr.ny.gov/Ads/Search  (ASP.NET POST-back; comprehensive but not simple-scrapable)
Georgia — Team Georgia Marketplace / PeopleSoft  (login required)
